spec.name: Halloween Purple Wrapped Sweet
spec.description: An original Orange SMP Halloween sweet with a chunky orange sugar centre, purple gathered collars and stepped, pointed twist wrappers. Axis-aligned geometry fits x0..16, y4..12, z4..12; open notches preserve transparent negative space.

prompt: Small purple wrapped Halloween sweet with pointed twist wrappers and orange centre, x0..16 y4..12 z4..12. Original Orange SMP Halloween asset. Vanilla Minecraft pixel scale, material-specific irregular detail, developed UV-mapped surfaces and purposeful connected cuboids. No text, no unrelated scene, no stands, no animations, no bones except the required armor rig. Preserve transparent negative space. Model geometry must be axis-aligned, with no rotated elements. Use local vanilla references for glass, pumpkin rind, wood, iron and inventory sprites. Generated artwork will be used directly in a Paper resource pack.
